[integration seat 09:45] PR #4046 (base integration) covers criteria 1 and 3: a PR with more than 250 commits is paged through compare/<base sha>...<head sha> with the same completeness proof (total equals the PR's count, last commit is the head, snapshot re-read). Verified live on #3905 (265 commits). dell1: 50 passed.

Criterion 2 is not written. Question for the advisor: after #4046 the only unreadable PRs are forge failures and PRs over 1000 commits. Skipping an unreadable PR relaxes a fail-closed check in train code, and "could name one of the train's specs" could only be judged from title and branch name. My recommendation: drop criterion 2 (or move it to its own spec with a sketch) and close this bug on 1 and 3. I will not write criterion 2 without your ruling.
subject: #4046 BUG-2583 (criteria 1+3) needs review; ruling wanted on criterion 2
